mapper.sql:
FROM community_message m LEFT JOIN user_profile sender ON sender.user_id = m.sender_id AND sender.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile recipient ON recipient.user_id = m.recipient_id AND recipient.is_deleted = 0 WHERE 1 = 1
AND m.sender_id = #{q.senderId}
AND m.recipient_id = #{q.recipientId}
AND m.read_at IS NOT NULL
AND m.read_at IS NULL
AND ( LOCATE(#{q.keyword}, m.content) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{q.keyword}, sender.nickname) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{q.keyword}, recipient.nickname) > 0 )
AND ( (m.sender_id = #{q.firstUserId} AND m.recipient_id = #{q.secondUserId}) OR (m.sender_id = #{q.secondUserId} AND m.recipient_id = #{q.firstUserId}) )
mapper.select:
SELECT m.id, m.sender_id, m.recipient_id, m.content, m.created_at, m.read_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(sender.nickname, ''), CONCAT('用户 ', m.sender_id)) sender_nickname, COALESCE(NULLIF(recipient.nickname, ''), CONCAT('用户 ', m.recipient_id)) recipient_nickname
ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
